scope: Exact batch.json projects; CPU-only written preparation requested 2026-11-08

No compulsory fresh game facts/search/download
fieldContract.claimLimits: array of concrete topic-specific limits/corrections, kept internal unless essential to lesson

publishingPlan.thumbnailConceptKo: object/problem/result sketch, no new asset generation
publishingPlan.descriptionDraftKo: short meaningful description; credits only if actually selected and at absolute end

readthrough.scope: text-only complete KO/EN narration and paragraph joins
readthrough.findingsKo: specific issues checked/repaired; not an audio review
readthrough.remainingKo: source/footage facts that cannot yet be asserted

rules: No fixed paragraph count, forced runtime, invented gameplay observation/rights/FHD/timestamps/measurements or human hearing.
Keep source logical order and useful depth. Expand essential missing reasons/prerequisites, not generic padding. Avoid every topic sharing generic narration or identical storyboard.
Source book artwork/reference media remain research-only. Proposed Unity scenes remain plans, not saved .unity assets.
All files additive. Do not alter frozen project checkpoints, old drafts, selected raw audio, complete outputs or unrelated metadata.
The schema is common for collection; extra meaningful per-topic fields are allowed. Preserved versions require truthful links/field extraction, not new narration.

oneChangedVariable may be null for a baseline, historical/contextual, or unverified actual-footage beat that is not a controlled comparison. Explain this in heldConditionsKo; never invent a manipulated variable.
Preserved-current-production packets may retain the single actually selected title instead of inventing replacement title alternatives for completed or frozen work.
